title: Mercantile Bank Corporation Increases Regular Cash Dividend
summary: Mercantile Bank Corporation (NASDAQ: MBWM) ("Mercantile") announced today that on July 16, 2026, its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per common share, payable on September 16, 2026, to holders of record as of September 4, 2026. The $0.40 cash dividend represents increases of 2.6 percent and 5.3 percent from the cash dividends paid during the second quarter of 2026 and third quarter of 2025, respectively. "Our steadfast commitment to building shareholder through meaningful cash returns was evidenced by our Board of Directors' declaration of an increased third quarter 2026 regular cash dividend," said Ray Reitsma, President and Chief Executive Officer of Mercantile. "We are pleased that our financial performance measures remained strong during the second quarter of 2026 amid persistent uncertainty in macro-economic and geopolitical conditions, which enabled us to once again provide shareholders with a competitive dividend yield.
